realms.title: The Threefold Reach
realms.brief: Find the missing surveyors before the charter is burned.
realms.architecture: A three-way road knot of mismatched mile markers, split-roof shelters, chalk archive vaults and a bell tower missing its casting seam.
realms.world: Refuge kettles are counted before wages; Bellwold lantern tenders walk the same lane that Paperhaven record runners insist never existed.
realms.hazard: Route splits acquire high-contrast chalk edging before the safe way changes.
realms.access: Persistent map and text clue; bell silence is also indicated by visible wick tremor and caption.
realms.public_principle: A witnessed promise outranks an inherited seal.
realms.scene: Wet paper and kettle steam; boot soles on mismatched paving; warm pockets of lantern gold.

evidence.verb: Compare the mold rim with the tower's missing casting seam
evidence.discovery: Metal never poured; indentations show hands holding a bell-shaped void.

evidence.verb: Align a refugee meal chit with a registry's blank date
evidence.discovery: The receipt predates the legal approval yet bears the same worn thumbmark.

evidence.verb: Follow a child's chalk route against a surveyor's stone mile
evidence.discovery: Both lead to the same kettle house from opposing directions.

witness.line: I hold a document proving this bell was never made. Your ears aren't evidence, but neither is my paper complete.
witness.arrival: I heard a bell from a road that doesn't exist. Who would carve a road into silence?
witness.return: You came back. A stranger can trace both shelter and archive routes, meeting residents who remember the chosen side. I have not forgotten the path you chose.

mechanism.line: I heard a bell from a road that doesn't exist. Who would carve a road into silence? The unanswered interval, a bell without a last note, gives you one chance to change the place responsibly.

care.objective: Preserve public shelter access and lantern use.
care.line: If we keep a roof open tonight, someone may live long enough to tell us what happened.
care.after: Preserve public shelter access and lantern use.

truth.objective: Make the missing record inspectable without forcefully identifying every protected resident.
truth.line: The archive can be public without naming people who asked for refuge.
truth.after: Make the missing record inspectable without forcefully identifying every protected resident.

realms.title: The Widowed Rain

realms.title: The Hearth Beneath

realms.title: The Sea of Written Debts

realms.public_principle: Nobody may pledge the tomorrow of a person who cannot consent.
